transition_l1_l2_description.en: Select suitable projects or work items for adoption, and define the technology adoption objectives, implementation scope, responsible personnel, and required resources.
transition_l1_l2_description.zh: 選定適合專案或安全監測與檢查工項進行導入，明確技術使用目的、執行內容、負責人與必要資源。

transition_l2_l3_description.en: Consolidate experience into basic procedures, documentation, and role assignments that can be repeatedly applied across different projects.
transition_l2_l3_description.zh: 整理經驗，建立基本流程、文件紀錄與角色分工，於不同專案重複執行。

transition_l3_l4_description.en: Standardise procedures, documentation, responsibilities, and review criteria, and integrate them into project management systems to ensure consistent implementation.
transition_l3_l4_description.zh: 統一流程、文件、權責與檢核標準，並納入工程專案管理制度，以確保一致落實。

transition_l4_l5_description.en: Regularly revise procedures, standards, and resource allocation based on performance data, audit results, and on-site feedback.
transition_l4_l5_description.zh: 依據績效資料、查核結果與現場回饋，定期修訂流程、標準與資源配置。
